about_the_game:
HellPunk - Gore Action Roguelite Game

HellPunk is a gore action roguelite game based in a steampunk-flavored hell. Blast your way through the horrific foes and inhabitants of Hell to reach the final chamber.

The Story

Asher Drake, the protagonist, lives a rough life.

His younger sister, the only family he had left, disappeared 20 years ago and he still travels the country trying to find out the truth behind her disappearance.

But one day, a freak accident strikes.

When he opened his eyes, all he saw was steam, running machinery, and... The tower.

Realizing that his sister is in the giant tower in front of him, he starts a death race up and down the hellish tower to find the truth about his missing sister.

Side-scrolling platformer action roguelite game

HellPunk is a roguelite-style action and platformer game with a different map and enemy composition every time.

Blood splattering, flesh falling gore action

Experience the essence of gore and grotesqueness as limbs are ripped off and blown away with every monster you kill.

Blast your way to the end of the Tower as you explode monsters with human flesh on top, ripped open, and exposed veins.

Stylish action with real-time weapon swapping

Pick up 2 of 7 different weapons themed to the 7 deadly sins and take on the challenge of conquering the tower.

Switch between weapons and combine your skills to take down monsters.

(※In this demo, there are two weapons: Sword and Gauntlet.)

Customize your build with a variety of upgrades

'Skill Swap' to switch out and enhance skills to your taste

(※There will be 4 skill change themes in the final version, but only 1 skill change theme is present in this demo)

'Gears' with different buffs inspired by Solomon's 72 Demons

(※There are 24 types of gear available in this demo)

'Operating Table' to grant permanent physical enhancements with bloodstones

Customize your build with a wide variety of compelling upgrades that match the unique atmosphere of HellPunk.

Diverse side stories

You'll meet a variety of interesting NPCs in your basecamp.

Each NPC has their own story and will ask you to help them with various tasks.

Their requests can be as simple as asking you to kill a monster, or as complex as forcing you to make a difficult, brutal choice.

Experience a unique and delicately crafted hell through quests.

(※There is 1 side quest available in this demo)

content_descriptors.notes: There is an excessive amount of blood splatter and the body decomposes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or AMD Phenom II X2 550
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 520, 1 GB or AMD Radeon HD 7470, 1 GB or Intel HD Graphics 4400
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-550 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710, 1 GB or AMD Radeon R7 240, 1 GB or Intel HD Graphics 530
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: HellPunk is a 2D action gore roguelite game. You play as the main character Asher Drake, who must help Leviathan conquer the Tower and solve the mystery of his family's vanishing.
